significance: A goddess temple between the villages of Goth and Manglod in Nagaur district, its antiquity fixed by an inscription of 608 CE. It is counted among the fifty-two Shakta pithas and is the clan shrine of the Dadhich Brahmins.
story: Dadhimati is said to have been born at the churning of the ocean and to have killed the demon Vikatasura in the Dadhi Sagar on Jaya Ashtami.
